name: @clue-harness/kb-web
description: The web host face of the knowledge base (M3c/M6/M9): same-origin JSON routes under /api/clue-kb on the dsh webserver — approval center, KB browser, entry ledgers, the原文/分片 routes (GET /doc, GET /chunks) and the human redline/split acts (POST /entry/redline, POST /entry/split) — plus the M6 AI-polish one-shot (host-layer llm call, engine stays model-free) and audited text adoption.
